items.q: You see, Bob, that being her husband's daddy too, she might have had, he might have had a picture something of the grandfather, you see, then I don't know, I don't remember that.

ctx.x: Of course it's mainly the musicians that I was interested in present, but... You know, I thought you could get maybe their father's pictures. Yeah, yeah, they were in there pictures.

You see, Bob, that being her husband's daddy too, she might have had, he might have had a picture something of the grandfather, you see, then I don't know, I don't remember that. So those people have been away there, everyone's been away so long.
